entities.name: Query GatC protein
observations: 95 aa protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q3J7V8.
Predicted GatC domain PF02686.21 spans residues 20–88.
Structural subunit of the heterotrimeric GatCAB amidotransferase complex; not itself the catalytic subunit.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 10,826 Da and predicted pI is 5.04.

entities.name: GatCAB amidotransferase
observations: Heterotrimeric complex composed of GatA, GatB, and GatC.
Produces correctly charged Asn-tRNA(Asn) or Gln-tRNA(Gln) from misacylated Asp-tRNA(Asn) or Glu-tRNA(Gln).
The overall reaction uses glutamine and ATP and proceeds through an activated phospho-aminoacyl-tRNA intermediate.
GatC forms a stabilizing belt around the GatA/GatB catalytic-subunit interface.
